e.title: Intact AI 领导
e.summary: Intact 引入银行技术老兵领导专业险种 AI 推进（加拿大险企 AI 领导）
e.body:
Intact（加拿大大型 P&C 保险公司）引入银行技术老兵领导专业险种 AI 推进（insurancebusinessmag）：加拿大险企的 AI 领导任命——专业险种（specialty lines）的 AI 推进。对 RIAA：险企 AI 领导的又一案例——与 [[nyl-chief-ai-officer]]（NYL 首席 AI 官）配套：美加险企 AI 领导案例；理解「专业险种 AI」的推进方向；跨界人才（银行技术 → 保险 AI）的职业信号；加拿大市场 AI 动态。

e.summary_hk: Intact 引入銀行技術老兵領導專業險種 AI 推進（加拿大險企 AI 領導）
e.body_en:
Intact (a major Canadian P&C insurer) brought in a banking-technology veteran to lead its specialty-lines AI push (insurancebusinessmag): an AI-leadership appointment of a Canadian insurer — the AI push of specialty lines. For RIAA: another insurer-AI-leadership case — with [[nyl-chief-ai-officer]] (NYL chief AI officer) it frames US/Canadian insurer-AI leadership cases; understand the direction of 'specialty-lines AI'; the career signal of cross-industry talent (banking tech → insurance AI); Canadian-market AI dynamics.
